knowledgePoints.title: 库存：快照与周转率
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：库存周转；延伸至积压、低库存、滞销和库存金额
knowledgePoints.concept: 库存是时点数量，销售出库是期间流量。周转率使用期间销售出库成本除期初期末平均库存成本。
knowledgePoints.syntax: sales_cost / NULLIF((opening_value+closing_value)/2.0,0)

columns.name: movement_type
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: WITH s AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date='2026-01-01' THEN quantity*10 ELSE 0 END) AS opening_value,SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date='2026-01-31' THEN quantity*10 ELSE 0 END) AS closing_value FROM stock_snapshots WHERE product_id=1 AND warehouse_id=1), m AS (SELECT SUM(quantity*unit_cost) AS sales_cost FROM stock_movements WHERE product_id=1 AND warehouse_id=1 AND movement_type='sale_out' AND movement_date>='2026-01-01' AND movement_date<'2026-02-01') SELECT ROUND(2.0*sales_cost/NULLIF(opening_value+closing_value,0),2) AS turnover FROM s CROSS JOIN m;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: WITH s AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date='2026-01-01' THEN quantity*10 ELSE 0 END) AS opening_value,SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_date='2026-01-31' THEN quantity*10 ELSE 0 END) AS closing_value FROM stock_snapshots WHERE product_id=1 AND warehouse_id=1), m AS (SELECT SUM(quantity*unit_cost) AS sales_cost FROM stock_movements WHERE product_id=1 AND warehouse_id=1 AND movement_type='sale_out' AND movement_date>='2026-01-01' AND movement_date<'2026-02-01') SELECT ROUND(2.0*sales_cost/NULLIF(opening_value+closing_value,0),2) AS turnover FROM s CROSS JOIN m;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 库存周转；延伸至积压、低库存、滞销和库存金额
knowledgePoints.comparison: 不能用销售收入除成本库存；不能汇总多个日期库存作为期末库存。

commonError.example: 把所有出库当销售出库
commonError.correction: 仅使用定义的销售出库类型

knowledgePoints.notes: 课堂明确固定单位成本10，快照均存在；正式项目缺快照不得默认为0。

knowledgePoints.useCase: 发票未付；延伸至费用、收入增长、异常金额与预算差异

knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：订单收货差异；延伸至采购成本、供应商履约、延误及发票核对

knowledgePoints.title: 零售：月度净销售增长率
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：分析月销售变动幅度
knowledgePoints.concept: 先计算按月净额，再在连续月份序列中读取上月金额；缺失上月或上月为零时增长率不可定义。
knowledgePoints.syntax: LAG(net_sales) OVER(ORDER BY month)

columns.name: status
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date,'%Y-%m') AS month,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount) AS net_sales FROM retail_orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date,'%Y-%m')), p AS (SELECT month,net_sales,LAG(net_sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev FROM a) SELECT month,net_sales,ROUND(100.0*(net_sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM p ORDER BY month;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date) AS month,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount) AS net_sales FROM retail_orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m',o.order_date)), p AS (SELECT month,net_sales,LAG(net_sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev FROM a) SELECT month,net_sales,ROUND(100.0*(net_sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM p ORDER BY month;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 分析月销售变动幅度
knowledgePoints.comparison: 环比对比上月；同比对比去年同月。

commonError.example: 直接比较单笔订单计算每月增长率
commonError.correction: 先按月汇总再使用 LAG

knowledgePoints.notes: 课堂仅两个月且连续；正式库须构建完整月份轴，题目明确缺失与无交易口径。

compatibility.detail: 需要明确转换或原生环境验证。

knowledgePoints.title: 电商：客单价
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：分析消费者每次购买的平均订单金额
knowledgePoints.concept: 客单价按有效订单净额合计除以有效订单数量，分母必须是订单而非明细行或顾客人数。
knowledgePoints.syntax: SUM(order_total)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0)

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT o.order_id,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount) AS order_total FROM commerce_orders o JOIN commerce_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS valid_orders,ROUND(1.0*SUM(order_total)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS avg_order_value FROM a;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT o.order_id,SUM(i.quantity*i.unit_price-i.discount_amount) AS order_total FROM commerce_orders o JOIN commerce_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS valid_orders,ROUND(1.0*SUM(order_total)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS avg_order_value FROM a;

knowledgePoints.concept: 以首次有效购买月份建立客户队列，统计首购客户在次月再次有效购买的比例。

knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: WITH first_buy AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(order_date) AS first_day FROM commerce_orders WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY customer_id), jan AS (SELECT customer_id FROM first_buy WHERE first_day>='2026-01-01' AND first_day<'2026-02-01') SELECT COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commerce_orders o WHERE o.customer_id=j.customer_id AND o.status='completed' AND o.order_date>='2026-02-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-03-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained,ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commerce_orders o WHERE o.customer_id=j.customer_id AND o.status='completed' AND o.order_date>='2026-02-01' AND o.order_date<'2026-03-01') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS retention_pct FROM jan j;
executionSteps: 找每名客户首次有效购买日期
knowledgePoints.useCase: 衡量首购客户次月复购情况
knowledgePoints.comparison: 次月留存固定队列；期间复购率面向整个统计窗口。

commonError.correction: 首购日期应基于完整的有效购买历史

knowledgePoints.notes: 完整历史与完整次月观察是必要条件。样例队列仅1人。

knowledgePoints.title: 财务：收入月度增长
knowledgePoints.learningObjective: 能够运用本节知识完成：监测收入环比走势
knowledgePoints.concept: 先按月汇总收入，再用 LAG 取得上一条月度记录。本课堂数据月份连续；实际月份缺档时必须先补齐月份轴，或明确标记同比/环比缺失。
knowledgePoints.syntax: 100.0*(income-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0)

columns.name: direction
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

knowledgePoints.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date,'%Y-%m') AS month,SUM(amount) AS income FROM transactions WHERE direction='income' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(transaction_date,'%Y-%m')), b AS (SELECT a.*,LAG(income) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev FROM a) SELECT month,income,ROUND(100.0*(income-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM b ORDER BY month;
knowledgePoints.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m',transaction_date) AS month,SUM(amount) AS income FROM transactions WHERE direction='income' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m',transaction_date)), b AS (SELECT a.*,LAG(income) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev FROM a) SELECT month,income,ROUND(100.0*(income-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM b ORDER BY month;
knowledgePoints.useCase: 监测收入环比走势
knowledgePoints.comparison: 现金收款收入与权责发生制收入不一定一致，题目需明确。

knowledgePoints.syntax: WITH a AS (SELECT v.supplier_id,COUNT(*) n,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.on_time>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) ot,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.accepted>=v.quantity_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) fill,100.0*SUM(accepted)/NULLIF(SUM(received),0) quality,100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN v.unit_price_cents<=c.unit_price_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) price_ok FROM v_po_lines v JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=v.po_item_id JOIN supplier_contracts c ON c.contract_id=i.contract_id WHERE v.promised_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY v.supplier_id) SELECT supplier_id,n due_lines,ROUND(ot,2) ontime_pct,ROUND(fill,2) complete_pct,ROUND(quality,2) quality_pct,ROUND(price_ok,2) contract_pct,ROUND(.4*ot+.25*fill+.2*quality+.15*price_ok,2) score FROM a WHERE n>=10 ORDER BY score DESC,supplier_id

parameters.金额: 整数马币分；比率按题设
